description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Summon the Meeting to fill the Vacancy Arose to the Post of Vice Chairman of the Padiyatalawa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: The gazette content is a notice summoning a meeting to fill a vacancy for the post of Vice Chairman of a local authority (Padiyatalawa Pradeshiya Sabha). This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, specifically addressing a vacancy and the procedure to elect a new officeholder, as governed by the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It does not involve central government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized administrative categories like Land, Legal, or Commercial matters.
